name: Callista
title: Registered Psychologist
description: 'I am a queer-identifying registered psychologist, dedicated to providing trauma-informed, evidence-based care.' Integrates DBT, Internal Family Systems, ACT & EMDR; special interests in PTSD, Autism and ADHD, anxiety & depression. 'I specialise in working with Neurodivergent, LGBTQ+ and Culturally Diverse Clients.' Monday and Tuesday.
specialties: EMDR, IFS, PTSD, LGBTQ+, neurodivergent, DBT, culturally diverse

name: Michelle
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Supports teens and adults with anxiety, depression and trauma, identity questions, racial and cultural identity, and gender and sexuality diversity. Perinatal specialist (birth trauma, perinatal loss, abortion grief, pregnancy options counselling). 'My practice is LGBTQIA+ affirming and neurodiversity affirming. I am particularly passionate about supporting non-binary clients through their reproductive experiences.' EMDR Level 1. Wednesdays, Saturday afternoons.
specialties: perinatal, birth trauma, trauma, non-binary, LGBTQIA+ affirming, gender and sexuality diversity, EMDR, pregnancy options counselling
identity: 'I identify as an Asian, neurotypical, cisgender woman.'

name: Maddy Bourke-Ibbs
title: Clinical Psychologist, Board Approved Supervisor
description: Works with teens and adults 16+ on anxiety, mood, identity, gender, neurotype. Also works at a paediatric Gender Service with significant experience working with trans and gender diverse young people to socially, legally and medically affirm their gender. Offers WPATH assessments for accessing gender affirming surgery and neurodiversity-affirming autism/ADHD assessments (18+). Uses CBT, ACT, DBT and Schema Therapy; identity-affirming. Mondays; not currently taking therapy referrals.
specialties: trans and gender diverse, gender affirmation, WPATH assessments, schema therapy, autism/ADHD assessment, hearing voices
identity: 'I am a white, cis and able-bodied woman.'

name: Edy
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Works with anxiety, depression, PTSD, ADHD, bipolar disorder and intellectual disability. Areas include Trauma and cPTSD, identity and cultural adjustment. Integrates Internal Family Systems (IFS), ISTDP, DBT, ACT and CBT. Tuesday & Friday.
specialties: PTSD, complex PTSD, trauma, IFS, ISTDP, DBT, cultural identity
identity: 'a registered psychologist with an immigrant background, having grown up in Australia'

name: Miss Semhar Hagoss
title: Psychologist
description: Psychologist committed to the wellbeing of young people and families; culturally sensitive and neurodivergent-affirming; 'I integrate a trauma-informed and intersectional framework into my practice.' Uses Narrative Therapy, Trauma-focused CBT, Internal Family Systems, ACT, Complicated Grief Therapy and Family Therapy. Mondays.
specialties: trauma-informed, TF-CBT, IFS, young people, families, grief

name: Marie Vakakis
title: Director, AMHSW, Couple and Family Therapist
description: Director of The Therapy Hub and host of This Complex Life. Couple and individual therapist using EMDR Therapy intensives, Gottman Couples Therapy Marathon intensives and weekly sessions; works with anxiety, stress, depression or trauma, identity. Areas include gender and sexuality exploration.
specialties: EMDR, EMDR intensives, couples therapy, Gottman, trauma, gender and sexuality exploration

name: Ozlem
title: Registered Counsellor
description: Warm, supportive, collaborative and trauma-informed. Draws on CBT, ACT, mindfulness, RLT, IFS/parts work, the Gottman Method and SFBT; couples counselling, anxiety, depression, grief. Speaks English and Turkish fluently. Wednesdays in person and online.
specialties: IFS/parts work, trauma-informed, couples, Gottman, Turkish

name: Amal Saleh-Zada
title: Registered Counsellor
description: Counsellor for over ten years working with adolescents, young adults and adults; particularly interested in men's mental health and young people from CALD, migrant and refugee backgrounds. Training in Safety and Stabilisation for complex trauma (Blue Knot) and Working with Survivors of Sexual Assault. Saturdays.
specialties: men's mental health, complex trauma, sexual assault, CALD, refugees

name: Stephanie
title: Counsellor and Registered Social Worker
description: Client-centred, solution-focused, strengths-based and CBT. Interests include supporting individuals dealing with trauma, self-harm, working with BIPOC and CALD communities, school refusal. Friday evenings & Saturdays.
specialties: trauma, BIPOC, CALD, young people, self-harm
